utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Eli — did the book club decide on the next pick yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but I’m expecting we’ll settle it at Thursday’s meeting. I’ll bring a short list of options so we can decide quickly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll try to make Thursday if I can. A short list should make it easy to pick something everyone’s into.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Leo, I’m a bit swamped—what’s the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s "The Lantern House" this month. I can send the details later if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send it later and I’ll take a look when I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the book club meeting still happening this week?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the time and place first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — let me know once you’ve confirmed the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the book club. I meant to bring my notes, but I’ve already forgotten which book we’re on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re on "The Lantern House" this week — I’ve got the extra handouts if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thank you — I’ll definitely need one. I’ll try to remember the title this time, but no promises.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club meeting you mean, and what detail you want me to check?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — I meant the next book club meeting. Could you check what day and time it’s on?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check that — do you want the regular meeting or the next special one?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — what book club pick are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re talking about this month’s pick, "The Midnight Library."

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh nice, I’ve heard good things about that one — what did everyone think of it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could I borrow your folding chairs for the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — you can borrow them for the meeting. Just let me know when you need to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at the little community room on Maple Street, but I should double-check the time too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds right — I can check the school calendar and see if it mentions the time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that would help a lot. If the calendar has it, let me know and I’ll jot down the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking the next read this week — I’m curious what everyone votes for!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I know, I’m keeping my ears open — if I hear the pick, I’ll let you know right away. If you want, I can also ping you when the next meetup gets set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, please do — I’d love that. I’m hoping they choose something fun, and I’ll keep my ears open too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at the library on Thursday, or did the book club move again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We’re still on for Thursday at the library.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring up the book club plans and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates from the others.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll do that and circle back once I’ve checked with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad we’re getting the book club started. Do you want to pick our first book together?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I’d like that. Something gentle would be nice for a first read.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — let’s choose something gentle and welcoming for everyone. I can bring a few good options to our next chat.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking something really good this month—if you want, I can find out what it is.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be helpful, Tess. I like knowing the plan ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the pick.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re just picking now. I’ll repeat the plan once we settle on the book.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — what are the options?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting a feel for the book club, but I’d like to hear what kinds of books you all usually pick.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We usually go for a mix—some fiction, a little poetry, sometimes something a bit more thoughtful. Nothing too heavy unless the group’s in the mood for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice—pretty approachable. I’d be happy to join one of the lighter picks first and see how it goes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure it’s the new mystery novel from the library—let me check the exact title and I’ll tell you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just let me know when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club sounds lovely—what are you reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got it right—are we reading the new mystery pick this week, or something else?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s the new mystery pick this week—sorry if I made that sound vague. I’m excited to hear what everyone thinks of it!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the book club. What book are we on again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re on "The Night Circus" this month — I can bring my copy to the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I think I missed that. I’ll read up and bring my notes next time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, book club? I’m always hearing little updates around the neighborhood — what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re meeting Thursday evening at the community room, and I’ve got a spare folding table if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s handy, thanks! I’ll spread the word that Thursday evening is set, and your folding table might save us a scramble.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help me pick the next book and send out the invite?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help pick the next book and send out the invite. Do you want me to choose from a few options, or do you already have one in mind?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and where we’ll meet. Do we already have the details sorted out?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — I can check the timing and book club spot, then send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, thank you. Once you have them, please send me the time and address so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Cleo, I’m so glad you’re here — the book club’s meeting this Thursday at my place, and I’d love for you to come!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, lovely — I’d be glad to come this Thursday. Do you want me to bring any snacks or tea?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be wonderful — tea would be lovely, and maybe a simple snack if you feel like it! I’m so happy you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do the book club around school pickup, but I’ll need the time pinned down first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll pin down a time and send it over. Thanks for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — once you send the time, I’ll make sure it works with pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely — I can help organize the book club if you’d like. What are you thinking for the first read?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Rosa. I heard folks mention a cozy mystery or maybe something short to start with—what do you think?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: A cozy mystery sounds perfect to start—easy to chat about and fun for everyone. I can put together a few short options and we can pick one together.
